definition.what: HERMES TV is a local-first smart TV agent interface for Android TV and Google TV. It connects a television to a Hermes agent runtime that the user owns and controls.
definition.who: People who run their own Hermes agent host and want a television control surface for it.
definition.does: It is being built to provide remote navigation, conversation, and optional voice control from the TV. Agents execute on the user-controlled host, not inside this website.
